title: Create static end to end signal path tests
description:
Create tests/StaticSignalPathTests.cpp using the built-in juce::UnitTest framework and register it in CMakeLists.txt on the existing console test-runner target. This is the final serialized CMakeLists.txt write of the phase and the phase's closing verification task.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/PluginProcessor.h and .cpp (the integrated processBlock and isBusesLayoutSupported from f.6)
- Source/DSP/FeedbackController.h (cross-feedback surface from f.2)
- tests/RoutingBypassTests.cpp and tests/SafetyHoldTests.cpp (the juce::UnitTest idiom already established)
- CMakeLists.txt (the console test-runner target and its target_sources list)

Required test coverage:
- Cross-feedback channel movement and stability at q = 0, q = 0.5, and q = 1. Assert q = 0 keeps a left-only impulse confined to the left channel, q = 0.5 produces equal energy in both channels after one repeat, and q = 1 moves energy to the opposite channel on each repeat (ping-pong). For all three, run a long bounded decay at maximum feedback and assert the output magnitude never exceeds a fixed bound and never grows over time.
- Bus layouts: mono-mono produces finite bounded output; mono-stereo produces valid deterministic stereo output with the dry component centered (left and right dry contributions equal within a stated tolerance) and no uninitialized channel content; stereo-stereo processes both channels.
- End-to-end impulse through the complete path: input gain, both voices, routing, stereo processing, safety, global mix, output gain — asserting a finite, non-silent, bounded response with repeats appearing at the expected delay positions.
- Zero tail: with the decay/tail control at zero, assert the wet path produces no sustained output.

Use only juce::UnitTest. Catch2, GoogleTest, and every other third-party framework are forbidden, and no new dependency may be introduced. Tests must be deterministic: fixed sample rates (48000 Hz and 44100 Hz), fixed block sizes, fixed generated signals, and no wall-clock dependence.

In CMakeLists.txt, add only tests/StaticSignalPathTests.cpp to the existing test-runner target sources.

tests/StaticSignalPathTests.cpp asserts an end-to-end impulse response is finite, non-silent, bounded, and shows repeats at the expected delay positions
tests/StaticSignalPathTests.cpp asserts the wet path produces no sustained output when the tail control is zero
